newsitem.title: USA: BankBoston to buy specialty finance firm.
newsitem.headline: BankBoston to buy specialty finance firm.

text.p: BankBoston said Tuesday it agreed to acquire GBFC Inc, a specialty finance company, from Gordon Brothers for $40 million.
GBFC is an asset-based lender devoted exclusively to meeting the financial needs of retailers. Boston-based Gordon Brothers offers a variety of restructuring services to the retail industry.
BankBoston said GBFC's 23 employees, including its management, would continue to work together as a separate unit of BankBoston.
The bank did not say when it expected the transaction to close.
A spokesman for Gordon Brothers said later Tuesday that the transaction is expected to close in two or four weeks.
